name: IDRiD Disease Grading Testing Set -- one-time external evaluation of the frozen Stage 1-8 pipeline
status: architecture development is frozen; IDRiD cannot change any model, rule or preprocessing decision

dataset.name: IDRiD -- B. Disease Grading, Testing Set (raw images)
dataset.images_manifest_definition: sha256 over the lines '<file name>:<sha256 of the file>\n', file names sorted

exclusion_reason.IDRiD_088: copy of segmentation image IDRiD_22 (Stage-4 v2 training)
exclusion_reason.IDRiD_089: copy of segmentation image IDRiD_31 (Stage-4 v2 training)
exclusion_reason.IDRiD_091: copy of segmentation image IDRiD_09 (Stage-4 v2 training)

dataset.primary_set: 100 images (103 minus the three exclusions) -- THE primary external result
dataset.sensitivity_set: 103 images -- computed after the primary result, labelled sensitivity analysis, never a replacement
dataset.note: the RAW tree is used; the already-preprocessed IDRiD tree would apply Stage 2 twice

stage4_unet.role: Stage 4 v2 lesion segmentation (SE-ResNet-101 U-Net), generation s4v2-cb5fc7a8d370-K4

convnext_pretrained.role: build dependency of P only (ImageNet file the P graph is constructed from; every weight is then replaced by the P checkpoint)

pipeline.stage1: IQA: frozen, not part of the grading graph
pipeline.stage2: stage4_v2_data.stage2_rgb: cv2.imread -> image_preprocessing.preprocess_array(profile='DR') -> RGB, native size, once
pipeline.rgb_frame: stage4_v2_aptos_cache.recompute_rgb_512: full-frame direct resize to 512x512 (no crop), float32 [0,1]
pipeline.stage3: stage4_v2_aptos_cache.recompute_vessel_512: LWNet on the native image with TTA, joint 512 resize
pipeline.stage4: stage4_v2.pathology_cache_maps: full-frame direct resize to 1536x1536, exact 3x3 mean + max pooling to 512x512, uint8
pipeline.p: pl_convnext.build_pl_model('P', seed): RGB frame in channels 0-2; BEST weights
pipeline.pathology: pathology_grader_model.build_pathology_grader: vessel map + Stage-4 maps, no RGB; BEST weights
pipeline.fusion: pathology_grader_severity_fusion.fuse_severity on P and pathology of the same seed

inference_source: Stage-4 APTOS cache manifest (Tesla T4, amp true, cudnn deterministic); P and the pathology grader were built and evaluated under mixed_float16 on a T4

fusion.decode: grade = number of k with fused_k > 0.5

fusion_note: the only final fusion; no other rule is computed on IDRiD

aggregation.interval: 95 % grade-stratified bootstrap over the test images (2,000 resamples, seed 20260927) of the seed mean

references.note: reference rows only; they do not influence any selection

parity.purpose: this code must reproduce the stored APTOS validation predictions before any IDRiD image is read
parity.subset_rule: the first two images of every grade in the authoritative 730-image validation order
parity.tolerance_source: RGB_PARITY_TOL, STAGE3_PARITY_TOL and CANARY_TOL_COUNTS are the project's existing constants; the logit and probability tolerances are set here for float16 logits (resolution 0.008 at |logit| 8-16)

rules: no repeated runs for better numbers
a rerun only for a technical failure, with the reason recorded
